payload.title: Holocene Ice Window Increment
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook analyzes Holocene ice core data to study climate variations. It utilizes the LiPD library to load datasets from a specified directory and processes them using various scientific computing libraries. The notebook focuses on selecting indices of interest manually and employs techniques such as mutual information to determine parameters. The outputs include processed datasets and visualizations of climate data.
goals: Study climate variations using ice core records

section_blurbs.blurb: The section introduces the analysis of Holocene ice core data, focusing on loading datasets using the LiPD library and selecting indices of interest manually. It employs mutual information for parameter selection and visualizes the data using various plotting libraries.
